outcome: Transfer to neonatal intermediate care unit
cohort: Uncomplicated twin deliveries at or after 32 weeks of gestation (n=717)
finding: While elective cesarean section was associated with better umbilical artery pH and Apgar scores in the second twin compared to unplanned cesarean or vaginal delivery, non-cephalic presentation of the second twin did not significantly influence perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Non-cephalic presentation of the second twin did not significantly influence perinatal outcomes but was associated with a higher risk of vaginal-cesarean birth.
